The change specification for `20261104-210402-refactor-require-react18` has been written and validated across `header.json` and `units-001.json` through `units-007.json` (88 units total):

- **`header.json`**: Defines repository conventions, architectural decisions, per-file checks (`prettier`, `test`), and full project checks (including the fixed study verification command, affected package test suites, and `yarn install --immutable`).
- **`units-001.json` – `units-003.json` (`U01`–`U58`)**: Updates `peerDependencies` (`react`, `react-dom`, `@types/react` to `"^18.0.0"`) across all 56 workspace manifests while preserving `peerDependenciesMeta["@types/react"].optional = true`, removes `use-sync-external-store` and `@types/use-sync-external-store` from `packages/frontend-plugin-api/package.json`, `packages/ui/package.json`, and `plugins/app/package.json`, and regenerates `yarn.lock` via a `yarn install` tooling unit (`U58`).
- **`units-004.json` (`U59`–`U65`)**: Updates `packages/repo-tools/src/commands/peer-deps/peer-deps.ts` to default to `^18.0.0` and drop the React-18-only exception set; switches `useRouteRef.tsx` and `useBreakpoint.ts` to `useSyncExternalStore` from `'react'`; updates `packages/dev-utils/src/devApp/render.tsx`, `packages/frontend-dev-utils/src/createDevApp.tsx`, and `plugins/techdocs/src/reader/transformers/renderReactElement.ts` to use `createRoot` from `'react-dom/client'` directly; and removes the legacy `ReactDOM.render` fallback test in `packages/frontend-dev-utils/src/createDevApp.test.tsx`.
- **`units-005.json` (`U66`–`U71`)**: Removes `hasReactDomClient` imports and `process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT` definitions from `packages/cli-module-build` (`config.ts`, `startFrontend.ts`) and `packages/cli-module-test-jest/config/jest.js`, updates `server.ts` `checkReactVersion()` to warn on React 16/17 and require React 18, deletes `hasReactDomClient.ts` (`U69`), and regenerates `packages/cli-module-build/knip-report.md` (`U70`).
- **`units-006.json` (`U72`–`U82`)**: Migrates `Popover.tsx`, `Tooltip.tsx`, `Table.tsx`, and `TablePagination.tsx` in `@backstage/ui` to `useId` from `'react'`; removes `LegacyRootOption` and `legacyRoot` from `@backstage/test-utils` (`testingLibrary.ts`, `appWrappers.tsx`) and regenerates `packages/test-utils/report.api.md` (`U78`); and updates all four `packages/cli-module-new` plugin templates to `^18.0.0`.
- **`units-007.json` (`U83`–`U88`)**: Updates `docs/tutorials/react18-migration.md` and `docs/tutorials/jsx-transform-migration.md` and creates `.changeset/{require,test-utils,cli,ui}-react-18.md` covering all 59 affected published packages.
